title: Goldreich–Levin threshold
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, its threshold is the Kushilevitz–Mansour threshold associated with its learning parameter and family-size bound; this threshold lies in $(0,1]$ and is supplied with the positivity condition on the family-size bound.
hypotheses_covered: The input has valid small-bias parameters: $n>0$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$
The Fourier $1$-norm bound is at least one
The family-size bound satisfies its positivity condition
caveat: The formulas for the learning parameter, family-size bound, and Kushilevitz–Mansour threshold are not included in the supplied upstream definitions.
